note: Boundary set for the under-specified-goal defect ('get the cream cheese ready' used to be answered with an invented destination). Frozen from the routing contract before this run: a goal with no destination and no heating outcome is an unfilled slot, so it is 'clarify'; a stated heating outcome still needs a place, otherwise the steps cannot be verified. The controls exist to catch the opposite failure (a real heating preparation downgraded to 'turn on stove', or the flow swallowing a single-capability request). Written before the run and never edited to match an answer; it is kept separate from config/flow_routing_cases.json so that the earlier frozen result stays a valid, untouched record.

expectation_kinds.flow: the whole household goal; the ordered keys are expanded from the flow catalog
expectation_kinds.composite: the user named separate capabilities in an order; keys are the user's own
expectation_kinds.clarify: a slot is unfilled (pronoun, missing place, missing level)
expectation_kinds.unsupported: specific enough to judge, and no capability or flow matches; a sub-request the flow excludes is never dropped

cases.rationale: Neither a destination nor a heating outcome is stated. The flow cannot supply the bowl, the stove or the switching-on from its own text.
Same slot as the English case; '准备好' alone leaves the place and the method unstated.
'Prepare' is the same empty goal in another word; no place, no heat, no stove.

cases.instruction: 帮我把奶油奶酪准备一下
cases.rationale: Politeness and a pronoun do not fill the two missing slots.

cases.instruction: get the cream cheese ready to heat up
cases.rationale: The heating outcome is stated but the place is not, so 'bowl then stove' cannot be checked against the instruction. A missing place is a clarify slot, not a licence to assume the stove.

cases.instruction: 帮我把奶酪加热准备好
cases.rationale: Same missing place in Chinese: heating is named, the destination is not.

cases.instruction: set the cream cheese up for heating on the stove
cases.rationale: Object, place and heating outcome are all stated, so the whole three-step preparation is required. Guards against over-correcting into clarify.

cases.instruction: 帮我把奶油奶酪准备好放到炉灶上加热
cases.rationale: Place and heating outcome stated in Chinese; the complete preparation must not be downgraded to switching the stove on.
One capability asked for; the flow must not swallow it.

cases.instruction: 帮我把奶油奶酪放进碗里就行
cases.rationale: One capability asked for ('就行' bounds the request); the flow must not add two steps the user excluded.
